question: Can the official 2019 BMB wetland inventory locality labels be linked to current PSA PSGC city/municipality codes for existing Quezon research leads?
method: Rechecked the original official PhilCHM-hosted DENR-BMB 2019 table rows on PDF pages 3-4 and linked their printed locality labels to current PSA PSGC codes. Updated only existing province-only administrative associations; kept the reported 2019 inventory context separate from exact feature location, current geometry, fish occurrence, or app admission.

limitations: The inventory is a historical 2019 compilation, not an exhaustive or current waterbody census; its printed areas are not adopted as current measurements or geometry.
The locality values are source-described LGU context. They are not coordinates, exact shoreline or peatland extents, or legal boundaries.
Tan-ag Ilaya is retained as a peatland lead and is not reclassified as a lake or fish habitat.
The separate Dagat Dagatan/Tayabas and San Antonio Dagatan/Pagatan naming conflict remains unresolved; this batch does not merge or alias those features.
No fish presence or absence, abundance, catchability, diet, salinity, hazard, access, fishing rule, or public-app claim is added.
